title: Enrollment Fees Added to the TRICARE Select Family Catastrophic Total for Corrected Stays
content:
**Adjudication rule.** Where the **TRICARE Select** tier's enrollment fees count toward the catastrophic cap and the payments posted on the fee account cover the installments whose coverage period has begun, those installments are added to the family catastrophic total of a corrected stay in full; where fees count and some but less has been paid, the payments posted are added; otherwise no enrollment fee is added.

An installment's coverage period has begun when it starts on or before the adjudication date; the fee account is read back over 600 months, taking in every installment of the enrollment.

## Tiers whose fees count

| Tier | Enrollment fees count toward the catastrophic cap |
|---|---|
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group A (E-1 to E-4) | no (fee-exempt) |
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group A (E-5 and Above) | no (fee-exempt) |
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group B (E-1 to E-4) | no (fee-exempt) |
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group B (E-5 and Above) | no (fee-exempt) |
| TRICARE Select Retiree Group A | yes |
| TRICARE Select Retiree Group B | yes |

## Amount added

| Fees count | Payments posted compared with begun installments | Added to the family catastrophic total |
|---|---|---|
| yes | equal to or more than them | the begun installments in full |
| yes | more than zero but less | the payments posted |
| yes | nothing paid | nothing |
| no | any | nothing |

## Hypothetical accounts (TRICARE Select Retiree Group B, quarterly family installments of 297.54)

- Three quarters begun (892.62 charged), 892.62 paid: 892.62 is added.
- Three quarters begun, 1190.16 paid (a quarter paid ahead): 892.62 is added, the begun installments in full.
- Three quarters begun, 595.08 paid: 595.08 is added.
